items.title: Persona continuity and session history
items.stopCondition: Do not add persistence migration while migration ledger is blocked.
items.managerTest: Five-turn chat resumes after close/reopen without mixing accounts.

items.title: Historical timezone and place resolution
items.stopCondition: Stop if the provider cannot prove historical offset or if license/data egress is unresolved.
items.managerTest: Same locality on DST transition asks for confirmation instead of silently changing time.

items.title: Typed canonical chart adapter
items.stopCondition: Do not promote status from draft until fixture and uncertainty tests pass.
items.managerTest: Chart facts appear before interpretation and retain engine/version provenance.

items.title: Birth precision and uncertainty UX
items.stopCondition: No ASC/house display as exact when time is unknown or place is unconfirmed.
items.managerTest: Unknown birth time produces useful limited chart with clear caveat and no false precision.

items.title: Fixture-driven SVG/2.5D chart spike
items.stopCondition: Stop if labels obscure facts, motion changes semantic positions, or low-end frame budget fails.
items.managerTest: Tap/highlight/filter exposes exact same chart data in visual and list modes.

items.title: Twelve mythology chapters with provenance
items.stopCondition: No chapter publish without source/provenance, safety copy and fallback asset.
items.managerTest: Chapter distinguishes general mythology from the user's calculated placement.

items.title: Chart to guide to journal handoff
items.stopCondition: No handoff if user has not granted context permission; no long-term memory by default.
items.managerTest: A selected Moon placement reaches the guide with the same placement id and returns to chart.

items.title: Release candidate privacy, credits and store evidence
items.stopCondition: No paid scale or production publish while critical privacy, calculation, payment or store evidence is missing.
items.managerTest: New account can reach chart, save, revisit, delete and restore entitlement without duplicate charge.
